output.title: Can a caregiver who is not an authorized caller set up a callback?
output.draft_text:
Q: Can a caregiver who is not authorized set up a callback?

A: Yes, but only a callback. A caregiver who is not listed as an authorized caller may set a callback time only. The approved source does not permit any other action for this caller.

What to do:
1. Confirm whether the caregiver is listed as an authorized caller by [method or system used to verify authorized callers].
2. If the caregiver is not listed, explain that you can schedule a callback but cannot [actions or information that are restricted for unauthorized callers].
3. Collect only [information the advocate may collect from the caregiver to schedule the callback, for example callback phone number and preferred time].
4. Schedule the callback within [allowed callback window or scheduling rules] and document it in [system or field where callback requests are recorded].
5. If the caregiver asks how to become an authorized caller, explain [process for adding an authorized caller].
6. The callback will be placed to [who receives the callback, for example the member or the caregiver's number] by [team or role responsible for the callback].
